```{r setup, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(dplyr)
```

---

## Shared Functions

```{r shared-functions}
# ---- Date parsing: tries multiple formats robustly ----
parse_yearmon_safe <- function(x) {
  if (is.na(x)) return(NA)
  fmts <- c("%Y-%m", "%Y/%m", "%m/%Y", "%b-%Y",
            "%b %Y", "%Y %b", "%Y%m", "%Y-%b")
  for (f in fmts) {
    attempt <- suppressWarnings(as.yearmon(x, format = f))
    if (!is.na(attempt)) return(attempt)
  }
  return(NA)
}

# ---- Trigger coincidence rate + Monte Carlo simulation ----
compute_rGt_mc <- function(s, deltaT, all_months, n_sim = 1000) {

  df_tmp <- tibble(
    time_index = all_months,
    fire_bin   = as.integer(all_months %in% s$Fire),
    hab_bin    = as.integer(all_months %in% s$Bloom)
  )

  total_fire_events <- sum(df_tmp$fire_bin)
  if (total_fire_events == 0) {
    return(list(obs = NA, sim_mean = NA, p = NA,
                ci_lower = NA, ci_upper = NA))
  }

  # Observed rGt
  fire_times <- df_tmp$time_index[df_tmp$fire_bin == 1]
  hab_times  <- df_tmp$time_index[df_tmp$hab_bin  == 1]
  triggered  <- 0L

  for (b in fire_times) {
    if (any((hab_times > b) & (hab_times - b <= deltaT))) {
      triggered <- triggered + 1L
    }
  }
  obs <- triggered / total_fire_events

  # Monte Carlo null distribution
  sims <- replicate(n_sim, {
    fire_rand    <- sort(sample(df_tmp$time_index, total_fire_events))
    hab_rand     <- sort(sample(df_tmp$time_index, sum(df_tmp$hab_bin)))
    triggered_mc <- 0L
    for (b in fire_rand) {
      if (any((hab_rand > b) & (hab_rand - b <= deltaT))) {
        triggered_mc <- triggered_mc + 1L
      }
    }
    triggered_mc / total_fire_events
  })

  list(
    obs      = obs,
    sim_mean = mean(sims, na.rm = TRUE),
    p        = mean(sims >= obs, na.rm = TRUE),
    ci_lower = quantile(sims, 0.025, na.rm = TRUE),
    ci_upper = quantile(sims, 0.975, na.rm = TRUE)
  )
}

# ---- Build grid site list from long-format data ----
build_grid_site_list <- function(df, hab_label = "hab") {
  unique_months <- sort(unique(df$yearmon))
  all_months    <- seq_along(unique_months)

  grid_site_list <- df %>%
    group_by(GRID_ID) %>%
    summarise(
      Fire  = list(unique(match(yearmon[Types == "fire"],     unique_months))),
      Bloom = list(unique(match(yearmon[Types == hab_label],  unique_months))),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    pmap(function(GRID_ID, Fire, Bloom) {
      list(grid_id = GRID_ID, Fire = Fire, Bloom = Bloom)
    })

  list(grid_site_list = grid_site_list, all_months = all_months)
}

# ---- Run ECA across all deltaTs and save results ----
run_eca_and_save <- function(grid_site_list, all_months,
                              deltaTs = 1:3, n_sim = 1000,
                              outfile) {
  results <- map_dfr(deltaTs, function(dt) {
    map_dfr(grid_site_list, function(s) {
      mc <- compute_rGt_mc(s, dt, all_months, n_sim = n_sim)
      tibble(
        GRID_ID      = s$grid_id,
        deltaT       = dt,
        obs_rGt      = mc$obs,
        sim_mean_rGt = mc$sim_mean,
        p_value      = mc$p,
        ci_lower     = mc$ci_lower,
        ci_upper     = mc$ci_upper
      )
    })
  })

  write.csv(results, outfile, row.names = FALSE)
  message("✔ Saved: ", outfile)
  results
}

# ---- Fire flag helper: was fire present in this grid in this year? ----
fire_flag <- function(df) {
  df %>%
    group_by(GRID_ID) %>%
    summarize(fire_year = any(Types == "fire"), .groups = "drop")
}
```

---

## 2020

```{r load-2020}
TessFireHAB2020 <- read.csv("TessFireHABGrid_ID.csv",
                              stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

# Normalize Month_Year
TessFireHAB2020 <- TessFireHAB2020 %>%
  mutate(
    Month_Year = trimws(Month_Year),
    Month_Year = gsub("\\.", "-", Month_Year),
    Month_Year = gsub("/",  "-", Month_Year),
    Month_Year = case_when(
      grepl("^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}$", Month_Year) ~ Month_Year,
      grepl("^[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{4}$", Month_Year) ~
        paste0(substr(Month_Year, 4, 7), "-", substr(Month_Year, 1, 2)),
      TRUE ~ Month_Year
    ),
    Month_Year_clean = ifelse(
      is.na(Month_Year) | str_trim(Month_Year) == "", NA, Month_Year)
  )

TessFireHAB2020$yearmon <- sapply(TessFireHAB2020$Month_Year_clean,
                                   parse_yearmon_safe)

bad_rows <- TessFireHAB2020 %>%
  filter(is.na(yearmon) & !is.na(Month_Year_clean))
if (nrow(bad_rows) > 0) {
  message("⚠️ Unparsed dates: ", paste(unique(bad_rows$Month_Year_clean),
                                        collapse = ", "))
} else {
  message("✔ All 2020 dates parsed successfully.")
}
```

```{r eca-2020}
eca_2020   <- build_grid_site_list(TessFireHAB2020, hab_label = "hab")
results_2020 <- run_eca_and_save(
  eca_2020$grid_site_list, eca_2020$all_months,
  outfile = "Trigger_Coincidence_GridCells_TessFireHAB2020.csv"
)
cat("NA counts:\n"); print(colSums(is.na(results_2020)))
```

## Combine All Years — Average TCR per Grid Cell

```{r combine-all}
# Bind results from all years (2019 loaded from saved CSV)
Grid_ID2019 <- grid_cell_trigger_coincidence_rate_with_CI %>%
  select(GRID_ID, obs_rGt) %>%
  mutate(YEAR = 2019)

all_data <- bind_rows(
  grid_cell_trigger_coincidence_rate_with_CI,
  results_2020,
  results_2021,
  results_2022,
  results_2023
)

avg_per_grid <- all_data %>%
  group_by(GRID_ID) %>%
  summarize(mean_obs_rGt = mean(obs_rGt, na.rm = TRUE),
            .groups = "drop")

cat("NA counts in avg_per_grid:\n")
print(colSums(is.na(avg_per_grid)))
```

---

## Fire Counts per Grid Cell (2020–2023)

```{r fire-counts}
# Tag each year dataset
TessFireHAB2020$YEAR          <- 2020
TessallationFireHabs2021$YEAR <- 2021
TessallationGridID2022$YEAR   <- 2022
TessfireHABsgridid2023$YEAR   <- 2023

# Flag grids with fire per year
f20 <- fire_flag(TessFireHAB2020)       %>% mutate(Year = 2020)
f21 <- fire_flag(TessallationFireHabs2021) %>% mutate(Year = 2021)
f22 <- fire_flag(TessallationGridID2022)   %>% mutate(Year = 2022)
f23 <- fire_flag(TessfireHABsgridid2023)   %>% mutate(Year = 2023)

fire_all <- bind_rows(f20, f21, f22, f23)

fire_counts20_24 <- fire_all %>%
  group_by(GRID_ID) %>%
  summarize(n_fire_years = sum(fire_year), .groups = "drop")
```

---

## Final Combined Dataset — Average TCR + Fire Counts

```{r final-dataset}
final_5year <- avg_per_grid %>%
  left_join(fire_counts20_24, by = "GRID_ID")

cat("NA counts in final_5year:\n")
print(colSums(is.na(final_5year)))
```

```{r save}
write.csv(fire_counts20_24,

          row.names = FALSE)

write.csv(final_5year,
          "11.26.25AvgTCR.csv",
```
